sentence: This project investigates topics in physics, including quantum computing, materials at very low temperatures, plasmas and the physics of the Universe.
This project maps how water moves through a subducting plate by studying its rocks and minerals.
This project builds AI systems that search outside sources of images and text to make more accurate decisions about images.
This project builds a tool that uses machine learning to speed up the simulation of nonlinear optical effects in fiber lasers.
This project studies how the plant hormone ethylene and a process in which cells recycle their own components influence each other.
This project builds software that lets programs in autonomous vehicles send messages to each other so that safety functions happen on time.
This project studies how a key cellular molecule changes ferritin, an iron storage protein, and how cells keep their iron in balance.
This project studies how genes shape the migration routes of a migratory bird and how hybrids taking intermediate routes survive.
This project builds an AI system that lets power grid protection relays keep adjusting their settings as grid conditions change.
This project builds machine learning methods that recover images of a scene hidden behind a scattering medium.
This project combines six existing datasets about early math learning in elementary schools into one dataset for wider use.
This project develops statistical methods to find causal relationships in text data and to tailor decisions to each individual.
This project tests whether the roughness of an energy landscape can help design damage-resistant alloys.
This project builds a portable, affordable virus test that pairs stable enzymes with an electrochemical biosensor.
This project builds neural network models that predict how chiral semiconductor nanocrystals interact with light.
